title: GameCraft Arcade
specs: 16 rotating local and New England craft beer drafts
Gamer-themed cocktails inspired by video games and pop culture
Must be 21+ to enter Monday through Saturday with valid ID; Sunday family day allows under 21 with parent/guardian supervision

Private room, entire second floor, or full venue available for reservations
Run Club and tournaments open to all skill levels
includes: Access to arcade and pinball machines
Tokens for games sold at bar in $5 intervals
gap: Exact token cost per game varies; most games cost 1-2 tokens, some 3-4 tokens
blurb: GameCraft offers over 100 arcade and pinball machines, local craft beers, and gamer-themed cocktails. It is a 21+ venue Monday through Saturday, with Sunday as Family Day allowing supervised guests under 21. Guests can enjoy complimentary Nintendo Switch gameplay at the bar.
extraNote: No kitchen; outside food permitted · Tokens sold at bar; cash or card accepted · Reservations not required for arcade entry; first come first serve · Private room and full venue reservations available · Inside Southington’s Factory Square, opposite side of the building from Witchdoctor Brewing and behind Smokin’ with Chris.
